title: Top Tier Charters

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: As the title says..... you do what you’d like and I just drive with as little talking as you desire. No need for awkward conversation or interactions. Read a book, spend time with a special loved one, listen to music while you cruise the lake, or catch up on some much needed R&R. Think of it as a limousine and you're in your own world! Top Tier Charters is the ONLY company that offers this service so enjoy the lake how YOU want to enjoy it! Let us customize your tour today! Tour is 2 1/2 hours for up to 6 guests and is customizable. Complimentary bottled water available but you are also welcome to bring your own beverages and snacks. ** $100.00 deposit required to hold your reservation.
